Testville Refinery crude unit shut after fire

Test Oil Co shut the main crude distillation unit at its Testville refinery on Tuesday after a fire broke out in the furnace area, according to a statement from the operator.

The unit can process 200,000 barrels per day. Nobody was hurt. The operator said the fire was put out within an hour and that the cause is under investigation by the site team.

Other units at the plant, including the vacuum distillation unit and the fluid catalytic cracker, were running at reduced rates on Wednesday. The company did not give a date for a restart of the crude unit and said it would update customers as repairs progress.

We are working to bring the unit back safely, a company spokesperson said.
